rules: One entry per vocabulary genre (a Discogs genre or an extra); the 11 families themselves are level 1 and not listed (the top-level 'families' block holds their synonyms). Every node below a family is a genre (ADR-0030).

parents: a non-empty unordered set (stored as a list) of unique names, each a family (level 1 name) or the key of another entry; all parents are equal, there is no primary parent (ADR-0037). The families of a genre are every family it descends from through any parent. The level is the shortest path depth to a family root (2 when a parent is a family, else 1 + the smallest level among its parents); there is no depth cap (the cap of three levels was lifted on 2026-10-19), only a sanity bound of 12 levels against bad data. Validation: every parent resolves, parents are unique and never the entry itself, no cycle through any parent.

family: not allowed on an entry; the families of a genre are derived from all its parents (the old override for the disco children is gone, they descend from disco, which sits in Funk / Soul and Electronic).
provisional: true marks an undrafted placeholder (all families except Electronic); parents is just the family.
discogs: true when the key is in genre_discogs.json, false when it exists only in genre_extras.json.

families: family name plus lowercase synonyms; genre entries may carry an optional synonyms list (carried over from ALIASES in genre_filter.py, read-only). A synonym never equals a vocabulary key, a family name or another synonym; typos are input normalisation, not synonyms.

modifiers: optional list of keys of the top-level 'modifiers' block ({name, kind sound|mood|scene, description}); a modifier alongside the tree, not a level. Only Electronic entries carry them so far.
status: optional 'approved' (Alex approved; only on entries with discogs false, because Discogs outranks his approval) or 'question' (under question, any entry); absent means unreviewed.
display: optional display name of a genre (default: the key); never equal, when lowercased, to another vocabulary key.

related: optional list of unique names (a family or the key of another entry), never the entry itself, one of its parents or one of its descendants. Associations and influences, not subgenre-of: no effect on the tree, levels, families, counts or colours; shown as information and a faint link in the map (ADR-0030, GEN-064).

Others: a family-block node with `group: true` and `temporary: true` is an organisational group (the former Electronic family, renamed 2026-10-20, task-0066): a level 1 node that is never a vocabulary entry, never a genre and never assigned to a song. Every genre that sat under Electronic has Others as parent instead. The `colour` of the group (Electronic) is the legacy colour family of the 11-family graph payload.

promoted genre: a family-block node that carries `discogs` (a boolean) is a genre promoted to level 1 (like Rock): it is a vocabulary entry (`level` family), its key is the family name, it may keep extra `parents` (a promoted node is level 1 whatever its parents), `related`, `synonyms`, `modifiers`, `fusion`, `display` and a `colour` (a family or group name, the colour family of the legacy graph; default its own name). Its children keep the same `parents` text and rise one level. Done by scripts/genre-ops.py promote.
